q: The Feldman-Moore theorem in descriptive set theory states that every countable Borel equivalence relation E on a standard Borel space X is:
opts: The orbit equivalence relation of a Borel action of a countable group Γ on X
Generated by a single Borel automorphism
exp: Feldman-Moore: every countable Borel equivalence relation E (each class is countable) arises as the orbit equivalence relation of some Borel action of a countable group Γ on X. This connects descriptive set theory to ergodic theory and is used to study invariants of CBERs.
